spec.name: Sofia
spec.archetype: FOMO chaser who buys late into runs

versions.statement: Sofia tends to panic and sell immediately after experiencing a losing trade, often locking in significant losses.
Sofia finds it challenging to ignore market noise and frequently reacts to every minor price fluctuation.
Sofia aims to implement a stricter risk management strategy to prevent emotional decision-making during volatile market periods.
Sofia prefers to take her time when making trading decisions, often resulting in her entering trades late.
Sofia strongly believes in the power of technical analysis and primarily relies on technical indicators to make trading decisions.
Sofia frequently succumbs to FOMO, buying into trades too late during market upswings.
Sofia successfully overcomes her FOMO by establishing strict entry criteria and sticking to them.
Sofia has relapsed into her old FOMO-driven habits, now often rationalizing late entries as strategic decisions.
